repos.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

repos.description: Become a cracked AI/ML researcher/engineer with this unconventional textbook covering maths, computing, and ML with intuition.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI/ML研究工程师的系统性学习资料库，涵盖数学基础、计算机科学和人工智能核心领域。内容强调直觉理解而非公式堆砌，从向量、矩阵、概率论等基础到Transformer、多模态学习、GPU编程等前沿技术。基于作者帮助多人成功入职DeepMind、OpenAI等顶级公司的实战经验，提供从理论到工程实践的一站式知识体系，适合面试准备和深度技术学习。
repos.summary_en: This is a systematic learning compendium for AI/ML Research Engineers, covering mathematics fundamentals, computer science, and core AI domains. Emphasizing intuitive understanding over dense notation, it spans from vectors, matrices, probability to cutting-edge topics like Transformers, multimodal learning, and GPU programming. Based on proven success in preparing candidates for top AI companies like DeepMind and OpenAI, it offers a comprehensive knowledge bridge from theory to engineering practice.

repos.description: 🔥 基于大模型和 RAG 的智能问数系统，对话式数据分析神器。Text-to-SQL Generation via LLMs using RAG.
repos.summary_zh: SQLBot 是基于大语言模型与 RAG 的智能问数系统，实现自然语言到 SQL 的精准转换。支持对话式数据分析（ChatBI），提供开箱即用的部署体验，内置工作空间隔离与细粒度权限管控。通过术语库与示例校准持续优化，支持 Web 嵌入、MCP 调用等多种集成方式，快速赋能业务系统智能查询能力。
repos.summary_en: SQLBot is an LLM-powered intelligent data query system leveraging RAG for accurate Text-to-SQL conversion. It enables conversational data analysis (ChatBI) with out-of-the-box deployment, featuring workspace isolation and fine-grained access control. The system continuously improves through custom terminology and SQL examples, offering flexible integration via Web embedding and MCP calls to rapidly empower business applications with natural language query capabilities.

repos.description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
repos.summary_zh: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
repos.summary_en: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库是系统性的机器学习教程集合，以Jupyter Notebook形式提供。内容涵盖深度学习、强化学习、时间序列等多个领域，核心特色在于平衡数学原理与工程实践：既包含NumPy/SciPy等科学计算栈的从零实现，也演示TensorFlow、PyTorch、scikit-learn等主流框架的工业级应用。适合希望深入理解算法底层并掌握实际部署技能的学习者。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a comprehensive collection of machine learning tutorials in Jupyter Notebook format. It covers diverse topics including deep learning, reinforcement learning, time series analysis, and recommendation systems. The key feature is balancing mathematical theory with hands-on implementation—both from scratch using Python's scientific stack (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, PySpark) and with popular frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost, and Hugging Face. It serves as an educational resource for learners seeking deep algorithmic understanding alongside practical engineering skills in model deployment and A/B testing.

repos.description: ML algorithms implemented and derived from first-principles in Jupyter Notebooks and NumPy
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 Jupyter Book 和 Marimo 构建交互式机器学习可视化平台，核心价值在于从第一性原理出发，使用 NumPy 纯 Python 实现神经网络、逻辑回归、PCA 等核心算法并配套数学推导。动态可视化训练过程，直观展示权重变化对损失函数的影响，是理解算法内部机制的顶级教学工具。
repos.summary_en: This project builds an interactive ML visualization platform using Jupyter Book and Marimo. It implements core algorithms—neural networks, logistic regression, PCA, etc.—from first principles with NumPy, accompanied by mathematical derivations. Dynamic visualizations show training progression and weight-loss relationships, serving as a premier educational tool for understanding algorithmic internals.

repos.description: A taxonomy for open source cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized ecosystems
repos.summary_zh: Electric Capital 推出的 Open Dev Data 是一个结构化的区块链与 Web3 开源生态分类法。它提供 CLI 工具链，支持按时间快照导出 JSONL 格式的仓库数据，并集成 DuckDB 实现本地高性能分析。通过交互式 SQL 界面，开发者可快速洞察比特币、以太坊等生态的子系统分布与项目演进，为生态研究提供精准数据基础。
repos.summary_en: Open Dev Data by Electric Capital is a structured taxonomy for blockchain and Web3 open-source ecosystems. It offers a CLI toolkit to export repository data in JSONL format with historical snapshots, integrates DuckDB for local high-performance analytics, and provides an interactive SQL interface. Developers can quickly analyze subsystem distributions and project evolution across ecosystems like Bitcoin and Ethereum, enabling precise ecosystem research.

repos.description: spoo.me is an open-source & API first link management infra
repos.summary_zh: spoo.me 是一个开源、API 优先的短链接管理服务，提供自定义 slug（含 emoji）、密码保护、点击限制等高级功能。其核心亮点在于强大的分析能力，支持地理位置、设备、流量模式、引荐来源和机器人检测的多维度统计，并提供 CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML 数据导出。无需注册即可使用，支持自托管，完全免费且无功能限制，适合需要私有化部署或集成短链能力的开发者和企业。
repos.summary_en: spoo.me is an open-source, API-first URL shortening infrastructure offering advanced features like custom slugs (including emojis), password protection, and click limits. Its core strength lies in comprehensive analytics covering geographic distribution, device breakdown, traffic patterns, referrer tracking, and bot detection, with multi-format data export (CSV/JSON/XLSX/XML). Requiring no registration, it provides completely free unlimited usage with self-hosting capability. Ideal for developers and enterprises needing private deployment or integrated link management with detailed click insights.
